historical_references.reference: Wasim was a famous Muslim general in the armies of the Sultanate of Delhi during the late 13th and early 14th centuries. He is best known for his victories over the Mongol invasions led by Möngke Khan in 1290 and 1295.

Wasim was also a key figure in the Deccan sultanate during the late 15th and early 16th centuries. He is remembered for his successful military campaigns against the Vijayanagara Empire and his establishment of the Bidar Sultanate in 1427.

In modern times, this name is popularly associated with three distinct areas: cricket, entrepreneurship, and media arts. Entrepreneurs might be familiar with Wasim Hussain, a Canadian entrepreneur who founded the social media analytics company, Social Media Slam Dunk.
